subject: science
title: Mirrors Reflect Light
objective: Describe how a mirror reflects light and how to protect our eyes.
introduction: Hi Maxine! 🪞 Milo wants to show you how a mirror reflects light. Let's see how light behaves — and how to keep our eyes safe!

items.explanation: A mirror bounces light back, so you can see yourself in it. A sponge, a sock, and a paper bag do not reflect like a mirror.

items.prompt: Which is the SAFE way to use sound?
items.explanation: A quiet voice is gentle on the ears, so it is a safe way to use sound indoors.

items.prompt: Which is the SAFE way to use light?

options.text: name a color in the room
count the books on a shelf
use a lamp to read in a dark room

items.explanation: A lamp gives enough light to read by, so it is a safe way to use light.

items.prompt: Which example shows how sound behaves?

options.text: a lamp lights a dark room

items.explanation: Shaking makes the bell vibrate, and that makes sound. Lamps, mirrors, and windows are about light.

items.prompt: Which example shows how light behaves?

options.text: a drum makes sound when struck

items.explanation: A mirror bounces light back, which is how it helps you see. Drums, bells, and claps make sound.
